title: SentiGOLD: A Large Bangla Gold Standard Multi-Domain Sentiment Analysis Dataset and its Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual token substitution of political names (e.g., replacing 'Bangabandhu' with 'Mir Jafor') to examine changes in the model's sentiment polarity predictions.
Evaluating sentiment polarity shifts when specific religious terms (e.g., 'Islam', 'Allah', 'Hinduism') are present or substituted in sentences.
